newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pac seen taking China Light stake - brokers.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pac seen taking China Light stake - brokers.

text.p: Trading in CITIC Pacific Ltd and China Light and Power Co Ltd shares was suspended on Tuesday prompting rumours that CITIC may take a stake in the Hong Kong utility company, brokers said.
"The market rumour is that CITIC is taking over China Light and Power," said Kenneth Poon, a trader at Lehman Brothers.
CITIC Pacific and China Light declined to comment on the suspensions and said an announcement would be made later.
"Basically, I think people expect CITIC Pacific bought a stake in China Light," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities.
"There is talk saying CITIC is going to buy 20 percent of China Light," said one trader at a regional brokerage. Another broker said he had also heard the 20 percent figure.
Shares in China Light rose HK$0.60 to HK$33.70 on Monday and CITIC Pacific added HK$1.10 to HK$39.50.
